## 🧠 About Web4hub

**Web4hub** is an experimental technology ecosystem exploring the convergence of:

```text
                    ┌─────────────────────┐
                    │      WEB4HUB        │
                    │  Open Digital Core  │
                    └──────────┬──────────┘
                               │
        ┌──────────────────────┼──────────────────────┐
        │                      │                      │
        ▼                      ▼                      ▼
   ┌─────────┐            ┌─────────┐           ┌───────────┐
   │   AI    │            │  WEB4   │           │ BLOCKCHAIN │
   └────┬────┘            └────┬────┘           └─────┬─────┘
        │                      │                      │
        └──────────────────────┼──────────────────────┘
                               ▼
                    ┌─────────────────────┐
                    │     SOFTWARE        │
                    │  Tools • Runtime    │
                    │  SDK • Apps • APIs  │
                    └─────────────────────┘
```

The goal is to provide a place where ambitious ideas can move from **concept → experiment → implementation → infrastructure**.

---

## 🚀 Ecosystem

### 🌐 Web4

Exploring persistent, intelligent, interconnected digital experiences.

**Projects**

* [`web4`](https://github.com/web4hub/web4) — Web4 experimentation
* [`web4.0`](https://github.com/web4hub/web4.0) — Web4 ecosystem experiments
* [`web4-publisher`](https://github.com/web4hub/web4-publisher) — Web4 publishing infrastructure
* [`app`](https://github.com/web4hub/app) — Web application experiments

---

### 🤖 Artificial Intelligence

Building intelligent systems, LLM infrastructure and AI-powered applications.

**Projects**

* [`Lmlm`](https://github.com/web4hub/Lmlm) — LMLM AI ecosystem
* [`Lmlmplugin`](https://github.com/web4hub/Lmlmplugin) — LMLM plugin infrastructure
* [`OmniSkel-AI`](https://github.com/web4hub/OmniSkel-AI) — AI application architecture
* [`awesome-ai-prompts`](https://github.com/web4hub/awesome-ai-prompts) — AI prompt experimentation

---

### ⛓️ Blockchain & Digital Infrastructure

Exploring decentralized infrastructure, identity, trust and programmable digital systems.

```text
Identity
   │
   ├── Trust
   │
   ├── Cryptography
   │
   ├── Wallets
   │
   ├── Distributed Systems
   │
   └── Blockchain
```

---

### 🛠️ Software Engineering

Web4hub also explores the foundations underneath the ecosystem:

* Programming languages
* Compilers
* Runtime systems
* APIs
* SDKs
* Cloud infrastructure
* Developer tooling
* Containers
* Automation
* Security
* Distributed systems

## 🔭 Current Direction

Web4hub is exploring an interconnected architecture where:

**AI + Web4 + Blockchain + Software Infrastructure**

work together as one technological ecosystem.

The broader vision includes intelligent applications, persistent identity, developer infrastructure, decentralized systems and next-generation web technologies.

---

## 🧪 Experimental by Design

Not every idea here is production software.

Some repositories are:

* 🔬 Research
* 🧪 Experiments
* 🏗️ Prototypes
* 🧰 Developer tools
* 🌱 Early-stage projects
* 🚀 Production-oriented infrastructure

That's intentional.

**Experimentation is part of the architecture.**
